ns2:course.label: Communications Internship
ns2:course.description: Supervised experience in a field directly pertaining to agricultural communications. Same as ALEC 293. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated up to 12 hours, if topics vary. Credit is not given for more than a total of 12 hours of Independent Study (IND) courses applying to a degree in ACES. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing. AGCM Program approval required.
